verdict.rationale: ZCode is documented as an AI coding workbench that spans desktop, browser and terminal-agent interfaces and claims multi-agent collaboration, which glancingly supports a unified place for agent-driven work. Nothing shows a single workspace for viewing, switching between or supervising multiple concurrent coding sessions. Missing for 10: documented multi-session management UI (listing, switching, monitoring parallel sessions), an engineering-lead oversight view, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can manage multiple agent-driven coding sessions from one unified workspace

citations.quote: ZCode 是 AI 编程工作台，提供桌面应用、浏览器界面和终端 Agent。
多智能体协作完成复杂目标
不会迁移或删除已有会话数据
